facts.fact: Replit began rolling Effort-Based Pricing out to remaining users on July 2nd.
facts.quote: we began rolling this feature out to the remaining users last week on July 2nd.

facts.fact: Replit offered $10 in free Replit credits to all members who used the new pricing model, applied automatically to active accounts.
facts.quote: we would like to offer $10 in free Replit credits to all Replit members who used the new pricing model

facts.fact: Replit states that a July 11th incident involving incorrectly computed checkpoint charges lasted from 11:26AM PDT to 5:43PM PDT.
facts.quote: happened on July 11th between the hours of 11:26AM PDT - 5:43PM PDT.

facts.fact: Replit states the July 11th incident affected approximately 6% of paying users.
facts.quote: This impacted approximately 6% of paying users.

facts.fact: Replit's first version of Agent (v1), which came out of beta in December 2024, billed a flat rate of $0.25 per checkpoint.
facts.quote: bill the user a flat rate of $0.25, which at the time was enough to cover the cost of AI and running the service.

facts.fact: Replit states that the v2 Agent can run autonomously for up to 20 minutes.
facts.quote: With v2, however, Replit can run autonomously for up to 20 minutes.

facts.fact: Replit states that 20 minutes of Agent work could cost it upwards of $10.
facts.quote: 20 minutes of work could cost us upwards of $10.

facts.fact: Before Effort-Based Pricing, Replit generated a checkpoint every ninth time the Agent ran a command behind the scenes.
facts.quote: we patched the Agent to generate a checkpoint every ninth time that the Agent ran a command behind the scenes.

facts.fact: Under the previous pricing model, each checkpoint cost the user $0.25.
facts.quote: Each checkpoint would cost the user $0.25.

facts.fact: Under Effort-Based Pricing, Agent creates at most one checkpoint per request.
facts.quote: Agent will create at most one checkpoint per request instead of many.

facts.fact: Under Effort-Based Pricing, simpler requests may cost as little as $0.06 per checkpoint.
facts.quote: Simpler requests may cost as little as $0.06 and more involved requests will usually cost more than $0.25

facts.fact: Under Effort-Based Pricing, more involved requests will usually cost more than $0.25 per checkpoint, sometimes resulting in charges of multiple dollars.
facts.unit: USD per checkpoint (typical minimum for involved requests)
facts.quote: more involved requests will usually cost more than $0.25, sometimes resulting in charges of multiple dollars depending on the size of the work.

facts.fact: Replit reports that some users have seen individual checkpoints costing over $1 under Effort-Based Pricing.
facts.quote: Users have seen checkpoints costing over $1, and they would have been charged the same amount under the old pricing model.

facts.fact: Replit reports that the cost per checkpoint under Effort-Based Pricing is determined by the amount of computing resources consumed.
facts.quote: The cost per checkpoint is now determined based on the amount of computing resources consumed.
